name: @quant-agent/desktop
description: aquant 研房 - 本地优先的 A 股多 Agent 研究桌面应用
author: Byeolyyy

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/copy-harness.mjs && electron-builder --win dir --x64
